source: Objective 2 Uttarakhand pipeline results (results/g10_selection_r*.json, g10_heldout_results.csv, wp6_band.csv, held_out_test.lock, obj3_environment_contract_uttarakhand_v2.json, configs/*.yaml). Built by src/handoff/build_obj3_contract_uttarakhand_v3.py; restructure only, no value changed.
supersession_note: RE-EXPRESSES results/obj3_environment_contract_uttarakhand_v2.json in the v3 schema that the Objective 3 code reads. Same designs, same limits, same held-out results; only the field layout and names changed. The legacy K = 5 contract (Phase-7 deployables, UTC-indexed demand, single-node tank; removed in the cleanup, git history only) stays superseded.

global_limits.note: HARD limits (renamed from the v2 keys delivery_temp_target_C / max_water_temp_C / max_pcm_temp_C / pump_flow_*). The controller may never command outside the flow envelope and may never drive water above max_safe_water_temp_C or PCM above max_safe_pcm_temp_C.

held_out_test.status: COMPLETED AND LOCKED by O2 - O3 must not tune against these years
held_out_test.coverage: The chosen design of each regime plus the best design of each other O1 PCM, over 2 held-out years. Rows with role 'best_of_pcm' are alternatives, not released designs.

gates_chosen_designs.note: g_window is the O2 gain in delivered energy to the delivery target (50 C for Uttarakhand; columns named 45 are computed at 50 C) in the 18:00-09:00 window versus the water-only twin. gain_serve_frac_45_mean is NOT positive in every row: PCM does not extend the time at the delivery target in the evening in every regime (plan section 0). Regime 3 is degenerate (no PCM gain). Counts are computed from g10_heldout_results.csv.

weather_sequences.enforcement: src/weather/roles.py refuses to load a year whose role differs from the stated purpose

action_notes.charge: circulate collector loop through the store (pump on, flow in [pump_flow_min, pump_flow_max])
action_notes.discharge: draw store -> load at delivery temp; collector loop off or idle
action_notes.bypass: collector loop bypasses the store (pump off / diverter) — the overheat-protection action

discrete_version.note: In the O2 kernel the only controllable element is whether the collector loop circulates; 'discharge' is passive PCM-water exchange and is physically identical to bypass at the kernel level.

continuous.flow_rate_kg_s: within the flow envelope in global_limits

hybrid_version.note: continuous-flow hybrid (mode in {charge, discharge, bypass} + continuous flow_rate_kg_s within flow_envelope_kg_s) — the pump range (0.010-0.050 kg/s) is continuous, so a discrete-only action space would discard usable control resolution

action_space.recommendation_note: The v2 text recommended the continuous-flow hybrid; the model's F_R is flow-independent (deferred_future_work), so a flow action would reward a model artefact. v3 therefore recommends the discrete version until F_R(flow) is enabled as a declared physics change.
action_space.hard_rule: the controller must never command a flow or temperature outside this regime's flow_envelope_kg_s / max_water_temp_C / max_pcm_temp_C — the safety shield below overrides the policy if it tries

reset_scenarios.name: partially_charged
reset_scenarios.note: PCM initialized at Tm_C (roughly 50% notional charge state)

reset_scenarios.name: fully_liquid
reset_scenarios.note: stresses discharge-heavy policies from a fully-charged start

acceptance_test_before_drl_training: every action stays within flow_envelope_kg_s / temperature limits above
the environment conserves energy (reuse Phase 4 Gate 1's <0.1% residual check)
the safety shield cannot be bypassed by the policy
the same seed reproduces the same trajectory
simulator output matches this Objective 2 re-evaluation for identical actions

dynamic_state_schema.description: One observation per control timestep. Fields marked measurable=false need an estimator (energy-balance + calibrated melt-fraction observer), not a raw sensor. T_pcm_C and f_melt are degenerate for the plain-tank regimes (no PCM) but kept in the vector for a state-invariant contract across future PCM-bearing states.

fields.name: f_melt
fields.source: estimator, derived from T_pcm_C via the frozen enthalpy model

fields.name: draw_mass_kg_now
fields.source: flow meter at the draw-off point

dynamic_state_schema.stratification_note: The tank is stratified: delivery temperature is the TOP node, the collector inlet is the BOTTOM node. recoverable_energy_above_45C_kWh is the WP1 E_rec,45 quantity (in Uttarakhand the threshold is the 50 C delivery target; the field keeps its cross-state name) and needs an estimator (not a raw sensor). Loop flow sets stratification, not collector heat, in this model.

safety_shield.enforced_in: src/simulation/tank_model_multinode.py - inside the numba kernel, not in the policy
safety_shield.note: Finding: the existing PCM-side shield only blocks CHARGING at 62 C and is not enough for PCMs already above their melt band; some designs exceed 65 C. A design is infeasible if its PCM peak exceeds 65 C in any simulated year. Hard requirement carried from the earlier contract. In the current model the shield acts on the TOP water node (start of sub-step) and on the PCM; plain-tank peaks reached 73.3 C in the multi-node model, below the 75 C limit (docs/PROGRESS.md section 6).
safety_shield.dry_run: pump commanded on, flow sensor reads ~0 -> stop pump, raise fault
safety_shield.sensor_failure: missing reading for a required field -> fall back to bypass (safe default), raise fault

reward_function.status: suggested (v2), weights NOT chosen: built from the WP1 metrics; Objective 3 sets and justifies weights
reward_function.formula: r_t = w1 * E_del45_t - w2 * overheat_step_t - w3 * safety_violation_t - w4 * bypass_switch_t, with E_del45_t the energy delivered up to the 50 C delivery target in the step (night and morning steps may be weighted more, WP1 window 18:00-09:00)

term_definitions.safety_violation_t: 1 if the TOP water node is at or above 72 C or the PCM is at or above 62 C (the shield guard band), else 0
term_definitions.bypass_switch_t: 1 if the mode changes into bypass at this step, else 0
term_definitions.overheat_step_t: shield-active time in the step (the quantity behind d_overheat)

reward_function.removed_terms: the earlier pump-energy term is removed: pump energy is not meaningful in the O2 model (Ergun pressure drop across the capsule bed only). The earlier normalisation constants and default weights came from the retired Phase-7 designs and are removed, not carried over.
reward_function.normalisation: to be computed by Objective 3 from the water-only twin of the chosen design over the explore years

design_space_caveats.statement: The designs are the best found WITHIN the declared design space (configs/design_space.yaml).
design_space_caveats.binding_bound_note: Regimes 0-2: R_in sits just under the 40 mm bound and the PCM fraction at 26-30 % (regimes 1 and 2 at the 30 % cap). Regime 3 is degenerate (about 2 % PCM). No widened-box (B1) test has been run for Uttarakhand.
design_space_caveats.flow_optimum_may_be_artefact: collector.flow_dependent_fr.enabled is FALSE, so F_R is flow-independent and a flow optimum is a model artefact.

temperature_specification.note: O2 MEASURES delivered energy at 50 C, the delivery temperature O1 also uses for Uttarakhand. Open decision (docs/05_LIMITATIONS_AND_OPEN_ITEMS.md): whether Uttarakhand adopts the 60 C O1 basis (needs a full O1 and O2 re-run). Every O3 metric and reward term must use delivery_target_temp_C, not 45 C.

verification_status.simulator_verification: see O2 docs/PROGRESS.md and results/g3_metrics_report.csv, g4_multinode_report.csv (Gate-1 residual in g10_heldout_results.csv)
verification_status.model_consistency_cross_check: OpenFOAM cases are set up in openfoam_cfd/ but NOT run for Uttarakhand (docs/PROGRESS.md section 15); results/g4_cfd_draw_case.csv compares the tank model with a CFD draw case. cfd_closure_v1 (Rajasthan's fit) is ported, off by default and UNVALIDATED.
verification_status.wording_rule: Say 'simulator verification' and 'model consistency check', never 'validated against experiment'.

deferred_future_work: experimental (hardware) validation of the simulator against a physical lab rig (Objective 4 scope)
regime 3 (cold high-altitude) rests on 3 O1 sampling points; its medoid weather is a thin basis
collector F_R(flow) correction: the model's F_R is flow-independent, so any flow optimum at 0.010 kg/s is a model artefact
CFD-derived PCM resistance correction is NOT applied (lumped r/(5k) with liquid-convection factor 2.0)
node-count (N=10 vs 20) uncertainty is inside the WP6 band, not removed
O1 conductivity: for Uttarakhand the ranking table and the PCM database agree for all 7 shortlisted PCMs (the Rajasthan discrepancy does not apply)
objective_boundary: Objective 1 selected the PCM shortlist. Objective 2 selected the released designs. Objective 3 may not change PCM, capsule geometry or count, tank volume, collector area, safety limits or physics.
